greeting.text: Thanks for calling Example Parcels. You're speaking with the automated assistant. I can track a parcel, check a delivery window, or report a missing parcel. How can I help?

greeting_chat_delegate.text: Hi {first}, I'm the Example Parcels assistant for depot staff. I can look up a customer's parcel. What do you need?

greeting_chat.text: Hi, I'm the Example Parcels assistant. I can track a parcel, check a delivery window, or report a missing parcel. What can I help with?

greeting_chat_signed_in.text: Hi {first}, I'm the Example Parcels assistant. I can track a parcel, check a delivery window, or report a missing parcel. What can I help with?

signin_required.text: To do that, I need you to sign in first. Use the Sign in button below, and I'll pick up where we left off.

signin_reminder.text: You can sign in with the button below, or ask me something else.

signin_ready.text: What can I help you with?

ask_intent.text: How can I help you today?

nomatch_open.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. You can ask to track a parcel, check a delivery window, or report a missing parcel.

nomatch_dtmf_menu.text: Let's try the keypad. To track a parcel, press 1. For a delivery window, press 2. To report a missing parcel, press 3. To speak with someone, press 0.

capabilities.text: I'm the Example Parcels assistant. I can tell you where a parcel is, check a delivery window, and take a report of a missing parcel.

confirm_intent_explicit.text: Just to check, you'd like to {intentLabel}. Is that right?

ack_frustration.text: I'm sorry this is taking a while.

offer_transfer.text: Would you like me to connect you with a support specialist?

ack_queued.text: Sure, I'll help with that next.

ack_intent_then.text: Sure, I can help you {a}, and then {b}.

system_slow_dtmf_hint.text: Sorry, I'm having trouble on my end. Please say that again, or use your keypad.

system_slow_chat.text: Sorry, I'm having trouble on my end. Please send that again.

ask_accountId.text: First I need to verify your identity. What's your account ID? It's the eight digits on your delivery notice.

ask_accountId_retry.text: Please say the eight digits of your account ID, one at a time.

ask_accountId_dtmf.text: Please enter your eight-digit account ID on your keypad.

ask_dob.text: And what's your date of birth?

ask_dob_retry.text: Please say your date of birth, including the year.

ask_dob_whole.text: Please say your whole date of birth: the month, the day, and the year.

ask_dob_dtmf.text: Please enter your date of birth as eight digits: two for the month, two for the day, and four for the year.

ask_dob_year.text: And what year were you born?

identity_failed.text: I couldn't match that account ID and date of birth. Let's try again.

ask_otp.text: For your security I need one more check. I've texted a six-digit code to the phone ending in {phoneLast4}. Please enter it on your keypad.

ask_otp_spoken.text: For your security, please enter the code on your keypad instead of saying it.

otp_spoken_reissued.text: For your security, I can't accept a code said out loud, so I've texted you a new one. Please enter the new code on your keypad.

otp_failed.text: That code didn't match. Please enter it again on your keypad.

ask_parcelSelect.text: Which parcel are you asking about? You can say the parcel number, or what's in it.

ask_parcelSelect_retry.text: Please say the four-digit parcel number, or what's in the parcel.

ask_parcelSelect_dtmf.text: Please enter the four-digit parcel number on your keypad.

disambiguate_parcelSelect.text: Did you mean parcel {a}, or parcel {b}?

parcel_status_in_transit.text: Parcel {parcel}, {item}, is on its way and due {day}.

parcel_status_out_for_delivery.text: Parcel {parcel}, {item}, is out for delivery today.

parcel_status_held.text: Parcel {parcel}, {item}, is being held at the depot. You can collect it with photo ID.

parcel_blocked_scope.text: I don't see that parcel on your account, and I can only share your own parcels.

parcel_blocked_scope_agent.text: I don't see that parcel for a customer your depot serves, so I can't share it.

report_blocked_role.text: Your role can't file reports. A depot clerk can file one with a person.

ask_deliveryDay.text: Which day would you like the delivery?

ask_deliveryDay_retry.text: Please tell me the day, like tomorrow, or Monday.

ask_deliveryDay_dtmf.text: Please enter the date as four digits: two for the month and two for the day.

ask_deliveryPart.text: Would you like it in the morning, the afternoon, or the evening?

ask_deliveryPart_retry.text: Please say morning, afternoon, or evening.

ask_deliveryPart_dtmf.text: For the morning, press 1. For the afternoon, press 2. For the evening, press 3.

window_full.text: On {day}, we don't deliver {part}. You can ask about another day.

ask_missingNote.text: In a sentence or two, describe the parcel and where it should have been left.

ask_missingNote_retry.text: Please describe the parcel, for example what was in it or where it should have been left.

ask_expectedDate_retry.text: Please tell me the day it was due, like yesterday, or September fifteenth.

ask_expectedDate_dtmf.text: Please enter the date it was due as four digits: two for the month and two for the day.

confirm_report.text: Let me make sure I have this right. You're reporting a parcel that was due {expectedDate}, and I have your description. Shall I file the report?

ask_change.text: What would you like to change?

confirm_dtmf.text: To file the report, press 1. To change something, press 2.

report_filed.text: Your report is filed. Your report number is {report}.

depot_result.text: The depot will search for it and call you within {days} days.

depot_unavailable.text: The depot will be in touch with next steps.

anything_else.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

goodbye.text: Thanks for calling Example Parcels. Goodbye.

goodbye_chat.text: Thanks for chatting with Example Parcels. Goodbye.

screen_reprompt.text: I can help with tracking a parcel, a delivery window, or a missing parcel.

handoff_live_agent.text: Connecting you with a support specialist now.

handoff_frustrated.text: I'm sorry for the trouble. Connecting you with a support specialist now.

handoff_max_attempts.text: Let me connect you with a support specialist who can help.

handoff_system_failure.text: I'm having trouble on my end. Connecting you with a specialist now.

handoff_identity.text: I wasn't able to verify your identity, so I'm connecting you with a specialist who can help.

handoff_needs_human.text: This one needs a specialist. Connecting you now.

handoff_security.text: I'm going to connect you with a support specialist.

handoff_role_person.text: Reports for a customer are filed with a person, so I'm connecting you with one now.

handoff_delivered.text: Our records show a parcel delivered to you that day, so I'm connecting you with someone who can check.
